goals.objective: Modernize /home/abdomahfoz/Projects/asp-template by porting the generic, domain-neutral parts of novatech backend onto .NET 10: shared-infrastructure parity (exception/result contract, repository + paging API, self-refreshing cache with a Redis backend, account/session and role admin), an xunit + WebApplicationFactory test harness with CI workflows and container packaging, and an OpenTelemetry/logging observability layer — on branch feat/template-modernization with one commit per bundle, verified by a green net10 build and green tests that smoke WebAPI endpoints through the test factory.

tasks.title: 1. Bump all 6 projects to net10.0 and align packages
tasks.verificationContract: On SDK 10.0.114: dotnet build WebAPI.sln exits 0 (0 errors). TargetFramework net10.0 in Models/Repository/Services/BusinessLogic/WebAPI/UnitTests csproj; EF Core + Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 10.0.x, JwtBearer/Mvc.NewtonsoftJson 10.x, Swashbuckle.AspNetCore 10.x, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk + xunit current; the Windows HintPath References (Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens 5.3.0, System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt 5.3.0) removed from BusinessLogic/BusinessLogic.csproj in favour of package refs; existing Models/Migrations still apply.
tasks.evidence: commit 9095847: all 6 csproj net10.0; EF 10.0.14/Npgsql 10.0.3/JwtBearer+NewtonsoftJson 10.0.14/Swashbuckle 10.3.1/Test.Sdk 18.11/xunit 2.9.3; HintPath refs gone; build 0 errors; ef migrations script

tasks.title: 2. Drop FluentValidation; validation via DataAnnotations + IValidatableObject
tasks.verificationContract: grep finds no FluentValidation reference anywhere; Services/Validators/UserAuthenticationRequestValidator.cs and both FluentValidation.AspNetCore PackageReferences are gone; WebAPI/Filters/ValidatorActionFilter.cs validates via ModelState/IValidatableObject and fails as ValidationException with FailureReasons; Services/DTOs/UserAuthentication.cs carries attributes plus a PagedRequestBase/LookupRequestBase + PaginationError pattern (PageIndex >= 1, PerPage <= 500, PerPage <= TotalItems). Test evidence: harness request with invalid login body and out-of-range PageIndex returns 400 with machine-readable error reasons.

tasks.title: 3. Port typed exceptions + middleware chain
tasks.verificationContract: New Services/Exceptions/{ValidationException(FailureReasons), NotFoundException(FailureReasons), ForbiddenAccessException} with a generalized FailureReasons enum (no clinical-trial vocabulary); Services/DTOs/ResultOrError<T,TE> with implicit conversions from T and TE plus [MemberNotNullWhen]; new WebAPI/Middleware/CommonExceptionsMiddleware.cs maps ForbiddenAccessException to 403 and NotFoundException to 404; WebAPI/Middleware/ErrorHandlingMiddleware.cs hardened with a response-already-started guard and swallowing ObjectDisposedException / InvalidOperationException / OperationCanceledException during failure writing; both registered in WebAPI/Program.cs after tenant resolution. Test evidence: a service throwing NotFoundException yields the mapped status and body through the test factory.

tasks.title: 4. Repository/IRepository parity + PagingService/ObjectHelpers upgrades (no site scoping)
tasks.verificationContract: Repository/IRepository.cs gains InsertAndReturnTrackedEntity(), UpdateRange(), SoftDeleteRange(), HardDeleteRange(), MarkModified<TP>(T instance, Expression<Func<T,TP>> property) implemented in Repository/Repository.cs while preserving existing tenant scoping and the ManipulationWait / TenantManager.ManipulationQueue deadlock fix; NO BaseSiteModel, SiteId filters, SiteManager/SiteActionFilter/GetAllIgnoringSiteScope anywhere (grep clean). Services/Helpers/PagingService.cs gains NormalizePaging, MakePagedResult<T,TRes>, MakeOrderByExpression for IQueryable and IEnumerable, Pagination overloads; Services/Helpers/ObjectHelpers.cs gets nullable-safe MapTo<T> and GetEnumOptions. Test evidence: xunit suite on EF Core SQLite covering CRUD, soft delete, hard delete, range ops, MarkModified, paging/ordering against Models/DataModels/SimpleModels/DemoModel.cs — all green.

tasks.title: 5. Self-refreshing cache (single ICache) + Redis backend
tasks.verificationContract: BusinessLogic/Interfaces/ICache.cs extended with InvalidateEntry(key), RegisterInvalidator<TService>(key, Func<TService,Task<object>> invalidator[, initialValue]), SetValue expiry overloads, set-entry Add/Remove/GetSetEntries and SetExpiration — no ILocalCache/IGlobalCache split. BusinessLogic/Implementations/Cache/MemoryCache.cs rebuilt with per-key ManualResetEvent invalidation locks, InvalidationWaitTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(50) and background refresh. New BusinessLogic/Implementations/Cache/RedisCache.cs on StackExchange.Redis selected by AppSettings.Redis { Use, ConnectionString, ValidateCertificate } in Models/Helpers/AppSettings.cs + WebAPI/appsettings.json (placeholder values only, no real credentials); Program.cs registers Redis impl when Use=true else MemoryCache. Test evidence: expiry test plus invalidator-callback test green; DI resolution test proves the Redis registration path without needing a live Redis.

tasks.title: 6. Account management, session invalidation, lockout and role-admin parity
tasks.verificationContract: BusinessLogic/Interfaces/IAccountLogic.cs + Implementations/AccountLogic.cs generalized: Register(request, roleId?, userId?), IsFirstLogin(userId), UpdatePassword(userId, currentPassword?, newPassword), Update(request, updatedBy), All(tenantId), GetById(id, tenantId), AllDeactivated(tenantId), ActivateUser(userId, activatedBy, tenantId). WebAPI/Controllers/AccountController.cs exposes Token / RefreshToken / Register / reset-password / Logout(LogoutRequest.IsFromAllDevices) / All / {id} / Update / deactivated / {id}/activate. BusinessLogic/Implementations/JwtAuthorization.cs and LoginValidator.cs port session validation via IAuth.Validate(userId, tokenDateIssued) plus account lockout threshold from options (AccountLockThreshold = 5) with TenantId and role-name claims only (no SiteId claim); Services/Extensions/ClaimsPrinicipalExtensions.cs gains GetRole() and InvariantCulture claim date parsing; Services/RoleSystem gains HasAnyRole(params RoleNames[]) and DbRoleValidator gains ValidateRoles / ValidateAnyRole backed by IPermissionsRepository.GetPermissionsOfUser; a generalized RoleSettings admin API (GetRolesWithUserCount / CreateRole / UpdateRole / GetPermissionsWithRoles / UpdateRolePermissions). Test evidence: harness suite green for login -> refresh -> logout-all-devices -> lockout after 5 bad passwords -> activate/deactivate flow -> role-guarded endpoint returns 403 for insufficient role.

tasks.title: 7. OpenTelemetry tracing + source-generated request logging
tasks.verificationContract: OpenTelemetry packages added to WebAPI (AspNetCore + EntityFrameworkCore instrumentation, OTLP exporter with console fallback) wired in WebAPI/Program.cs from a config-driven Observability section; Tracer injected into Repository<T>, cache and logic layers with spans named like Repository<T>::Method via new Repository/Extensions/SpanExtensions.cs (SetAttribute(key, DateTime) as UTC invariant string); WebAPI/LoggerExtensions.cs uses [LoggerMessage] HttpSuccess(EventId 1) / HttpFailure(EventId 2); new WebAPI/Middleware/RequestResponseLoggingMiddleware.cs logs controller/action/client IP (X-Forwarded-For honoured through an explicit configurable client-IP header list)/parameters/status/duration; forwarded headers enabled in Program.cs. Test evidence: build green plus an ActivityListener-based test proving a request produces the repository span and the HttpSuccess log entry.

tasks.title: 8. xunit WebApplicationFactory harness + CI workflows
tasks.verificationContract: UnitTests/Base.cs provides MainWebApplicationFactory<TProgram> : WebApplicationFactory with EF Core SQLite backing, a Db accessor, Setup(), CreateAuthenticatedClient(roleNames) / CreateAuthenticatedToken(roleName), and seeding helpers for users/roles/DemoModel; UnitTests/AssemblyInfo.cs disables parallelization; UnitTests/UnitTests.csproj adds Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing + coverlet.collector + ReportGenerator, keeps xunit/Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk, and drops <Compile Remove="UnitTest1.cs" />; Models/ApplicationDbContext.cs gains ctors accepting a SqliteConnection or an explicit connection string. .github/workflows/pr_tester.yml restores, builds and tests with coverage on ubuntu-latest using setup-dotnet 10.0.x; .github/workflows/cd.yml reproduces deployScript semantics (merge master into deploy branch and push) with no hard-coded credentials; the deployScript shell file is deleted; README documents the new branch/test/CI flow. Test evidence: dotnet test fully green end-to-end through the factory (this doubles as the required WebAPI endpoint smoke).

tasks.title: 9. Container packaging for the template
tasks.verificationContract: New multi-stage Dockerfile (net10 aspnet base runtime, SDK publish stage publishing WebAPI/WebAPI.csproj only — no Scripting project, no cloudflared or other vendor tunnel glue) plus .dockerignore covering bin/obj/node artifacts; docker build completes successfully from the repo root when docker is available locally (otherwise a documented dry-check of the publish stage is recorded and flagged to the user).
